visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit classroom with a young woman sitting in the foreground. She has a long black braid and wears a white halter top and black leggings. Behind her, four young girls in school uniforms stand or sit near wooden bookshelves and colorful cubbies. (2) The woman brings a silver transverse flute to her lips and begins to play. As she plays, the girls behind her react with excitement; one girl on the left raises her hand high while others smile and move rhythmically. Yellow star and red heart icons appear as overlays. (3) The woman stops playing, lowers the flute, and gestures toward the children. One girl speaks animatedly. The woman smiles, nods, and points to the side. (4) This sequence repeats through several short musical segments. Each time the woman plays a new melody, the girls raise their hands or jump slightly in a guessing game format. (5) In the final phase, the woman waves her hand toward the camera while holding her flute, and the girls behind her wave and smile as well. The scene remains static within the classroom setting.
